partners.mechanism_chain: THRB (HGNC:11645) —DISRUPTS→ Thyroid hormone signaling pathway (WP:1222); Thyroid hormone signaling pathway (WP:1222) —LEADS_TO→ Thyroid hormone resistance (HP:0000860); NR3C2 (HGNC:7702) —DISRUPTS→ Mineralocorticoid receptor signaling pathway (WP:399); Mineralocorticoid receptor signaling pathway (WP:399) —LEADS_TO→ Hypertension (HP:0000822); Mineralocorticoid receptor signaling pathway (WP:399) —LEADS_TO→ Hyperkalemia (HP:0002174); Mineralocorticoid receptor signaling pathway (WP:399) —LEADS_TO→ Metabolic alkalosis (HP:0011321). Loss-of-function mutations in THRB impair thyroid hormone action, leading to generalized resistance (Disease A). Gain-of-function mutations in NR3C2 hyperactivate mineralocorticoid receptor signaling, causing pseudohyperaldosteronism type 2 with hypertension, hyperkalemia, and metabolic alkalosis (Disease B).
